local function SGARWPG_fake_script() -- GBSKBTN.GBSKBTN_Client 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', GBSKBTN)

	local button = script.Parent
	local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
	
	local function findAncestorByName(instance, targetName)
		while instance and instance.Parent do
			instance = instance.Parent
			if instance.Name == targetName then
				return instance
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	
	local function smoothTween(guiObj, sizeUDim2, posUDim2, duration)
		local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local tween = TweenService:Create(guiObj, tweenInfo, {Size = sizeUDim2, Position = posUDim2})
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Wait()
	end
	
	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		-- Zoek naar de tool in Workspace
		local backstageKey = nil
		for _, obj in Workspace:GetChildren() do
			if obj:IsA("Tool") and obj.Name == "Backstage Key" then
				backstageKey = obj
				break
			end
		end
	
		-- Zet de tool in de backpack van de speler
		if backstageKey then
			local player = Players.LocalPlayer
			if player and player:FindFirstChild("Backpack") then
				backstageKey.Parent = player.Backpack
			end
		end
	
		-- Traverse omhoog tot MainFrame
		local mainFrame = findAncestorByName(button, "MainFrame")
		if not mainFrame then return end
	
		-- Zoek TopBar in MainFrame
		local topBar = mainFrame:FindFirstChild("TopBar")
		if not topBar then return end
	
		-- Smooth animatie naar grote/positie
		smoothTween(topBar, UDim2.new(0,329,0,47), UDim2.new(0.351,0,0.02,0), 0.5)
	
		-- Zoek ImageLabels
		local trueIco = topBar:FindFirstChild("TrueIco")
		local keyAppIco = topBar:FindFirstChild("KeyAppIco")
	
		if trueIco then trueIco.Visible = true end
		if keyAppIco then keyAppIco.Visible = true end
	
		task.wait(3)
	
		if trueIco then trueIco.Visible = false end
		if keyAppIco then keyAppIco.Visible = false end
	
		-- Smooth animatie terug naar origineel
		smoothTween(topBar, UDim2.new(0,236,0,47), UDim2.new(0.394,0,0.02,0), 0.5)
	end)
	
	
end
coroutine.wrap(SGARWPG_fake_script)()

local function YRLNPLW_fake_script() -- ScreenGui.ScreenGuiDrag 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', ScreenGui)

	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	
	-- Find the main draggable frame (usually the main window)
	local screenGui = script.Parent
	local mainFrame = screenGui:FindFirstChild("BackGround")
	if not mainFrame then return end
	
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart = nil
	local startPos = nil
	
	mainFrame.Active = true
	mainFrame.Selectable = true
	
	mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
	        dragging = true
	        dragStart = input.Position
	        startPos = mainFrame.Position
	        input.Changed:Connect(function()
	            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
	                dragging = false
	            end
	        end)
	    end
	end)
	
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
	        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
	        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
	            startPos.X.Scale,
	            startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
	            startPos.Y.Scale,
	            startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
	        )
	    end
	end)
	
	
end
coroutine.wrap(YRLNPLW_fake_script)()
